name: shadow_tier2_directional
description: CEQR Tier 2 directional screen. Eliminates sensitive resources that lie within the triangular zone south of the project site that can never receive shadow (between ±108° from true north). Resources remaining in the 'can be shaded' arc proceed to Tier 3 analysis.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction for analysis. NYC uses CEQR ±108° threshold.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites GeoJSON from Tier 1 output or custom dataset. If omitted, uses default NYC dataset.

sites_requiring_tier3.description: Sensitive sites that could potentially receive shadow and require Tier 3 analysis

sites_eliminated.description: Sensitive sites ruled out by Tier 2 directional screen

no_shadow_zone.description: The triangular zone south of the building that can never receive shadow

triggered.description: True if any sensitive sites remain after Tier 2 screening (Tier 3 required)

summary_report.description: Summary of Tier 2 directional screening results

visualization.description: Interactive map showing building, no-shadow zone, and site classifications
